newsitem.title: USA: Freeport-McMoRan says to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Freeport-McMoRan says to buy back shares.

text.p: Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc said Wednesday that its board of directors authorized a new 20 million share repurchase program.
The mining company said the repurchase of both its class a and b common stock represents roughly 10 percent of all its shares oustanding.

The company said in a statement that the repurchases will occur over time and be dependant upon factors including market prices, the company's operating results, cash flows and financial position as well as general economic and market conditions.

In addition to the repurchase announcement, Freeport said Rio Tinto, a 12 percent stake holder elected to place its chief executive copper, Jonathan Leslie on the Freeport board. He switches places with Leigh Clifford, Rio Tinto's chief executive energy. The changes occured following Rio Tinto's reorganization.
